name: Chordism
author: Charles Vestal
tagline: one key in, a chord out
description: Chordism turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into a chord synth. Each key plays a four-voice chord, from sixteen chord types, your own intervals, or a chord for each note of the scale. The sound runs through morphing levels and pans, FM, a filter that opens as you press harder, lo-fi, a delay and a plate reverb, with an arpeggiator on top. It comes with the Chordism module's 57 sounds and 16 slots for your own.
credits: Chordism, the Schwung module (MIT). Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments). Bluetooth: Optimist's stack by Henri David (MPL-2.0). Fonts: Barlow (SIL OFL 1.1).
